structural_consequences: B6.7 test test_payload_digest_mismatch_produces_refusal now fails — it relied on transient intent execution without authority. This is expected: the legacy bypass is structurally eliminated. B6.7 must be migrated to pre-materialize intents before execution.

B6.6 tests pass because their assertions are loose (check annotation presence only). They also receive canonical_materialization_required refusal rather than execution, but the test does not distinguish.

build_validation_handoff() does not populate admitted_validation_profile or bounded_paths. Lane B cannot claim fully constrained validation recovery until Lane D releases a populated validation handoff contract.
